groups.transcript:
W: Good afternoon, Jason. Have you received the updated catering invoice from Grand Oak Convention Center for our awards banquet?
M: Yes, Lisa, but I noticed they charged us for two hundred dinner plates when our confirmed attendee count was only one hundred and seventy.
W: Oh, that's a difference of over one thousand dollars. Did you call their banquet manager to verify the count?
M: I called her office twenty minutes ago, and she apologized for the administrative error. She promised to send an amended invoice with the correct amount before 4:00 P.M.
groups._speech: Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation. Good afternoon, Jason. Have you received the updated catering invoice from Grand Oak Convention Center for our awards banquet? Yes, Lisa, but I noticed they charged us for two hundred dinner plates when our confirmed attendee count was only one hundred and seventy. Oh, that's a difference of over one thousand dollars. Did you call their banquet manager to verify the count? I called her office twenty minutes ago, and she apologized for the administrative error. She promised to send an amended invoice with the correct amount before 4:00 P.M.

questions.content: What discrepancy did Jason discover on the banquet invoice?
options: The company was charged for thirty extra dinner plates
The event hall rental fee was doubled
The date of the awards banquet was incorrect
A mandatory gratuity fee was omitted
questions.explanation: Jason phát hiện hóa đơn tính tiền 200 suất trong khi chỉ có 170 khách (chênh lệch 30 suất) → Chọn (A).

questions.content: How much is the cost discrepancy approximately?
questions.explanation: Lisa nói: "Oh, that's a difference of over one thousand dollars" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What did the banquet manager promise to do before 4:00 P.M.?
options: Send an amended invoice with the correct figure
Provide free floral centerpieces for all tables
Visit the company headquarters in person
questions.explanation: Jason cho biết quản lý hứa gửi hóa đơn sửa đổi trước 4 giờ chiều ("She promised to send an amended invoice with the correct amount before 4:00 P.M.") → Chọn (A).

All department heads must submit their finalized budget proposals for the upcoming fiscal year no later than Friday, November 18 at 5:00 P.M. questions.content: What is the speaker mainly announcing?
options: A reduction in travel reimbursement rates
A transition to a new corporate banking partner
The election of a new board of directors
questions.explanation: Người nói thông báo về thời hạn nộp đề xuất ngân sách cuối năm ("important announcement regarding our year-end budgeting deadlines") → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What must supervisors use when preparing their submissions?
options: The updated spreadsheet template on the intranet
A printed physical ledger from accounting
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc: "Please remember to use the updated spreadsheet template available in the corporate intranet portal..." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What event is scheduled for Wednesday morning?
options: An open financial briefing with the executive board
A software training workshop on accounting tools
A retirement luncheon for senior accountants
questions.explanation: Người nói nêu: "...the executive board will host an open financial briefing on Wednesday morning..." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: All travel expense reports must be submitted for managerial ------- by the final business day of the month.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ "managerial" cần một danh từ để tạo thành cụm danh từ "managerial approval" (sự phê duyệt của cấp quản lý).

questions.content: The auditing committee emphasized that all client financial records must remain strictly -------.
questions.explanation: Động từ nối "remain" đi với tính từ chỉ tính chất. Sau phó từ bổ nghĩa "strictly" cần tính từ mang nghĩa bảo mật → chọn "confidential" (bảo mật, bí mật).

questions.content: The chief financial officer reviewed the balance sheet figures ------- before distributing them to investors.
questions.explanation: Câu đã đầy đủ chủ ngữ, vị ngữ và tân ngữ. Đại từ phản thân "himself" đứng cuối mệnh đề để nhấn mạnh chính ông CFO làm hành động kiểm tra.

questions.content: Employees will be reimbursed for allowable travel expenses ------- they submit original itemized receipts.
questions.explanation: Liên từ điều kiện "Provided that" mang nghĩa "với điều kiện là / miễn là" đi kèm một mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh.

questions.content: Reimbursement checks will be deposited into employees' bank accounts ------- ten business days.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "within" + khoảng thời gian mang nghĩa "trong vòng / không quá mười ngày làm việc".

groups.passage:
MEMORANDUM
To: All Department Supervisors
From: Gregory Simmons, Chief Financial Officer
Date: November 3
Subject: Updated Corporate Travel Guidelines

Effective December 1, all staff members traveling on corporate business must adhere strictly to our revised travel reimbursement guidelines. Under this updated protocol, all flight and hotel arrangements must be booked [131] ------- our designated corporate travel management portal to secure negotiated corporate rates.

Employees will no longer receive reimbursement for personal incidental charges, such as hotel minibar purchases or dry-cleaning services. [132] -------. Itemized expense claims, accompanied by scanned copies of official receipts, must be submitted within 14 calendar days of returning from travel.

Failure to provide documented receipts on time will lead to reimbursement [133] -------. Should you have questions regarding allowable per-diem meals, please check the intranet directory or [134] ------- the finance department directly.

questions.content: Choose the best preposition to fill in blank [131].
questions.explanation: Giới từ "through" mang nghĩa "thông qua cổng quản lý công tác được chỉ định" ("through our designated corporate travel management portal").

questions.content: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank [132].
options: Such personal charges must be settled directly by the individual traveler.
Our annual product demonstration was well attended by international guests.
The customer service hotline operates twenty-four hours a day.
Parking permits will be issued at the security booth tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Câu trước nói về việc công ty không hoàn tiền cho chi phí cá nhân (mini-bar, giặt ủi). Câu (A) nối tiếp logic: "Các chi phí cá nhân như vậy phải do chính người đi công tác thanh toán".

questions.content: Choose the best noun form to fill in blank [133].
questions.explanation: Sau danh từ "reimbursement" cần danh từ để tạo thành cụm danh từ ghép "reimbursement delays" (sự chậm trễ trong hoàn trả chi phí).

questions.content: Choose the best verb form to fill in blank [134].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc song hành với động từ nguyên mẫu đứng trước liên từ "or": "please check ... or contact ... directly".

questions.content: When must the remaining balance of $10,400 be settled?
questions.explanation: Trong mục Financial Terms: "Remaining Balance Due: $10,400 payable on or before November 28" → Chọn (A).

groups.passage:
MEMORANDUM 1
To: Senior Management Team
From: Teresa Alvarez, Chief Procurement Officer
Date: October 15
Subject: Office Printer Fleet Replacement Bids

Our current leasing contract for multi-function office copiers with Lexmark Office Solutions expires on December 31. Over the past three months, the procurement committee solicited bids from three commercial vendors to replace our fleet of 24 copiers across three regional branches.

After evaluating print quality, monthly maintenance turnaround, and volume pricing, the committee recommends partnering with Apex Imaging Services. Apex offers high-speed laser printers with integrated cloud scanning at a monthly lease rate of $3,800, which is 12% lower than our current contract. In addition, Apex guarantees a four-hour on-site maintenance response time.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MEMORANDUM 2
To: Teresa Alvarez, Chief Procurement Officer
From: Marcus Sterling, Chief Executive Officer
Date: October 17
Subject: RE: Office Printer Fleet Replacement Bids

Dear Teresa,
Thank you for the thorough comparative analysis. Given the cost savings and the four-hour service response guarantee, I fully approve the committee's recommendation to award the leasing contract to Apex Imaging Services.

Please proceed with drafting the formal five-year agreement with their legal team. Prior to signing, ensure that the contract includes complimentary installation and staff training during the first week of January so our daily workflow remains uninterrupted.

Best regards,
Marcus Sterling

questions.content: Why did the procurement committee recommend Apex Imaging Services?
options: Lower monthly lease pricing and a rapid maintenance guarantee
They are the only vendor offering color photocopy machines
Their corporate headquarters is located next to Apex Studio
They agreed to buy back old office furniture
questions.explanation: Ủy ban đề xuất Apex vì chi phí thuê hàng tháng thấp hơn 12% và cam kết phản hồi kỹ thuật trong vòng 4 tiếng ("monthly lease rate ... 12% lower ... guarantees a four-hour on-site maintenance response time") → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What condition does Mr. Sterling require before signing the agreement?
options: Complimentary installation and staff training in early January
A further five percent discount on paper supplies
Replacement of all office desktop computers
An option to terminate the lease within six months
questions.explanation: CEO Marcus Sterling yêu cầu: "ensure that the contract includes complimentary installation and staff training during the first week of January" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What is the duration of the proposed contract?
questions.explanation: CEO chỉ đạo: "Please proceed with drafting the formal five-year agreement..." → Chọn (A).
